contributions.anchor: line 1 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED' Column A 'Total this Period' (28,413.88) on the p6 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also the ledger's own printed 'Donations: $ 28,413.88' at the foot of Schedule A sheet 2 and is repeated at summary line 5 'Subtotal'
contributions.detail: 63 contribution rows over two ledger sheets. Sheet 1 (p2, 34 rows) sums to 9,468.85; sheet 2 (p3, 29 rows) sums to 18,945.03; together 28,413.88 exactly = the ledger's printed 'Donations' total = summary line 1 Column A = line 5 (line 3 Balance at Beginning is a typed 0). A SECOND independent gate on the same sheet also closes: the 'Amt Loaned' column (28 rows) sums to 9,656.88, the figure printed beside the Donations total, and the printed 18,757.00 beneath it equals 28,413.88 - 9,656.88, which is exactly what the 35 non-loan rows sum to. NOTE this summary page leaves line 4 ('From Line 1 Column A') and line 6 ('From Line 2 Column A') EMPTY while lines 1, 2, 3, 5 and 7 carry figures — honest blanks in the filer's own hand-off between lines, and the ADDENDUM A3 blank-cover recovery is not needed because lines 1 and 2 themselves carry the figures. Column B (Year-to-Date) is empty on both lines, so nothing cumulative is claimed or summed. LOANS: the 28 candidate rows marked in 'Amt Loaned' are inside the promoted 28,413.88 and line 3 is 0, so the ladder makes them itemized contribution rows (ADDENDUM B3).

expenditures.anchor: line 2 'TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE' Column A 'Total this Period' (21,410.78) on the p6 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also the ledger's own printed 'Summary of Expenditures/Loan Repayments: $ 21,410.78' at the foot of Schedule B sheet 2
expenditures.detail: 55 expenditure rows over two ledger sheets. Sheet 1 (p4, 36 rows) sums to 8,983.78; sheet 2 (p5, 19 rows) sums to 12,427.00; together 21,410.78 exactly = the ledger's printed total = summary line 2 Column A. The ladder closes as printed: line 3 (0) + 28,413.88 = line 5 (28,413.88), minus 21,410.78 = line 7 'Balance at Close' 7,003.10 — even though the filer left lines 4 and 6 blank, both figures are stated at lines 1 and 2. Column B is empty on line 2.

in_kind_convention: monetary-only — the ledger has no in-kind column, no row carries an in-kind annotation and the summary page prints no in-kind line. Both conventions were tested on both sides: monetary-only closes exactly (28,413.88 / 21,410.78) and there is no in-kind figure to add, so the two conventions coincide. The filer's 'Amt Loaned' column is a LOAN marker (a subset of the contribution rows), never added to the sum.
escalation_note: No figure needed a legibility escalation: the schedules are the filer's own typed spreadsheet reproduced crisply and each side carries two independent printed totals (plus the loan/non-loan split on the contribution side), which confirmed all 118 amounts to the cent on the first reading. The twelve geometry proof crops listed in the frames were rendered at 900 dpi on THIS document's own pages. The county's address bars on pp2-3 do not touch the money columns.

2.measure_note: *** ORIENTATION, and it differs from this filer's other filing. *** These schedule sheets are the filer's own typed LANDSCAPE ledger, and on THIS document the PDF page carries /Rotate 270 (pdfinfo), so poppler renders the page UPRIGHT as a 2194x1698 landscape image and both make_snippet and rowbands work in that ordinary frame: axis='y', rows advance top-to-bottom, columns left-to-right. (The same ledger inside key dd75bb17 carries /Rotate 180 and renders SIDEWAYS in a portrait frame, needing axis='x'. Orientation is a per-DOCUMENT property here and must be read off pdfinfo/the render, never carried across.) rowbands.py returns ZERO printed rules on the page (the ledger is ruled only by whitespace), so the bands were measured by INK PROJECTION restricted to the money column and proved by crop.
